title: Binary Digits Under Increment
statement: For every natural number $n$, there are a natural number $p$ and a Boolean list $v$ such that either the binary digits of $n$ consist of $p$ ones followed by a zero and then $v$, or they consist of $p$ ones with $v$ empty; the binary digits of $n+1$ then consist of $p$ zeros followed by a one and then $v$.
